intro.h2: Your cabinet maker in Warner Robins
paragraphs: Cleghorn Cabinets is a cabinet maker in Warner Robins with a shop at 108 Constitution Dr. Richard Cleghorn is listed as the company's CEO, and reviewers name the people who helped them, Mr. Cleghorn and Mr. Ricky, rather than a sales desk.

about.text: Cleghorn Cabinets is a cabinet shop at 108 Constitution Dr in Warner Robins, Georgia. items.q: Who will I be working with?
items.a: Richard Cleghorn is listed as the company's CEO in a Georgia business directory, and customers mention Mr. Cleghorn and Mr. Ricky by name in their reviews. When you call (478) 953-6996, ask who will measure your kitchen and build your cabinets.

The shop is at 108 Constitution Dr, Warner Robins, GA 31088. Google currently shows the business as open 24 hours, which is unlikely for a cabinet shop, so call (478) 953-6996 before you drive over to make sure someone is there.

items.q: Can I send photos of my kitchen first?
items.a: Yes. Email clegcabs@aol.com with a few photos of the room, rough measurements and the door style or finish you like, or call (478) 953-6996 to talk it through. Sending the details first gives the shop a clear picture of your kitchen before you meet.

items.q: How is a cabinet job priced?
items.a: Call or email with your kitchen measurements, a rough layout and a few photos of the room. Prices depend on size, finish and the cabinet details you choose. Estimate terms are not published, so ask how pricing works when you first get in touch.
